title: Generating cloned sheep embryos by zona-free somatic cell transfer
author: Zachariah L McLean
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.begbjbsn
materials: Enucleate zona-free oocytes Enucleation occurs between 20-22 hpm.
Dissect ovaries from the reproductive tract and place in a thermos in saline at 30 °C for aspiration within 2–4 hours of collection.

steps.title: Induce Donor Cell Quiescence
steps.instruction: Seed donor cells at approximately 2.5 x 10^4 cells/cm^2 in duplicate wells (5x10^4 cells per well in a 4-well plate or 5x10^3 cells in a 96-well plate).

substeps.instruction: Wait 6-20 hours after seeding before starting serum starvation.
Wash cells once with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Add starvation medium (DMEM/F12 + 0.5% FBS) for 4-6 days without changing the medium.

steps.title: Retrieve and Prepare Oocytes
steps.instruction: Collect ovaries from mature ewes (identified by two adult central incisors) during breeding season (February-July).

substeps.instruction: Rinse ovaries briefly in 70% ethanol to sterilize.
Rinse thoroughly in 30 °C saline 2-3 times.
Aspirate follicles (1 mm - 5 mm) using a vacuum pump (~43 mmHg) into 2 mL - 3 mL of oocyte aspiration medium in a 15 mL tube.
Change tubes after filling to ~7 mL and maintain at 30 °C.

steps.title: Select and Mature Oocytes
steps.instruction: Isolate cumulus-oocyte complexes (COCs) and mature them in vitro.

substeps.instruction: Transfer aspirated follicular sediment to a 90 mm dish with warmed aspiration medium.
Under a stereomicroscope (warm stage 38.5 °C), select COCs with intact cumulus layers and homogenous ooplasm.
Wash COCs serially through two dishes of H199+FBS, then once in B199+FBS.
Transfer 10 COCs in 10 µL B199+FBS into a 40 µL drop of IVM medium in a 60 mm dish overlaid with mineral oil (max 12 drops per plate).
Mature oocytes overnight at 38.5 °C in humidified 5% CO2 with atmospheric O2.

steps.title: Remove Cumulus Cells and Zona Pellucida
steps.instruction: Remove the cumulus cells and the zona pellucida from MII-arrested oocytes 19 hours post-onset of maturation (hpm).

substeps.instruction: Move oocytes from IVM drops into H199+FBS, then transfer up to 200 oocytes into 500 µL 1 mg/mL hyaluronidase (in H199) in a 1.5 ml tube.
Vortex COCs for 1.5 minutes (2000-2200 rpm) to disperse cumulus cells.
Briefly centrifuge, collect oocytes, and transfer back into H199+FBS (rinse the hyaluronidase tube to recover all oocytes).
Quickly wash oocytes through a fresh dish of H199+FBS, then transfer to H199+BSA.
Screen for the presence of a polar body; discard oocytes without one.
Place polar body-containing oocytes into a 50 µL drop of pronase solution for 30 s – 2 min (process ~50 oocytes at a time).
If zona is resistant, use a ~120 µm pipette to release the oocyte or use a glass pipette to tear the zona.

steps.title: Enucleate Oocytes
steps.instruction: Remove the metaphase chromosome-spindle complex from the oocytes.

substeps.instruction: Wash oocytes in H199+BSA and allow 5–15 min recovery.
DNA stain oocytes in groups of ~40 for 5 minutes in 5 µg/mL Hoechst 33342 in H199+BSA+Caffeine.
Wash DNA-stained oocytes in H199+FBS and transfer to a H199+FBS droplet on a 30 °C stage.
Locate the metaphase plate under 20x objective (brightfield) and confirm with UV light.
Aspirate the chromosome-spindle complex into an enucleation needle with minimal cytoplasm.
Separate the karyoplast from the cytoplast by tapping the stage or using a separation needle; confirm aspiration via UV exposure.
Transfer batches of 40 cytoplasts into the 'cytoplast plate' (30 per drop).
Transfer zona-free oocytes in groups of 30 into drops in the 'oocyte plate' until enucleation is complete.

steps.title: Prepare Donor Cells and Form Couplets
steps.instruction: Prepare donor cells and attach them to cytoplasts using lectin.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with PBS, trypsinize, and inactivate trypsin with warmed H199+0.5% FBS.
Centrifuge, remove supernatant, and resuspend at ~1 x 10^5 cells/mL in H199+0.5% FBS; aliquot into 40 µL drops under oil.
Distribute a few hundred cells across four drops of 'lectin plate' (20 µg/mL PHA-P).
Transfer ~80 cytoplasts (10 per drop) into the remaining lectin drops and incubate for a few minutes.
Attach a cytoplast by dropping it on a cell, rolling it for adherence, and moving the couplet to a drop without donor cells.
Incubate couplets in lectin for at least 5 minutes, keeping them separate.
Wash couplets through H199+BSA+Caffeine and store in the 'couplet plate' (max 10 per drop).

steps.title: Electrofusion of Couplets
steps.instruction: Perform somatic cell transfer (SCT) via electrofusion at 22-24 hpm.

substeps.instruction: Wash 20-40 couplets through H199+BSA+Caffeine, then through two dishes of calcium-free fusion buffer.
Flood a fusion chamber (attached to a 90 mm dish with Blu-Tack) with room temperature fusion buffer; remove bubbles.
Transfer 5-20 couplets to the chamber; align with AC field (83 V/cm) for 5–10 s.
Apply 2 x 10 µs, 2 kV/cm DC pulses to aligned couplets (manually align any remaining).
Return couplets to fusion buffer, wash through H199+BSA+Caffeine, and place in 'post-fusion plate' (10 per drop) for scoring 10–30 min post-pulse.

steps.title: Chemical Activation
steps.instruction: Activate the reconstructed embryos 3–4 hours post-fusion.

substeps.instruction: Wash fused reconstructs through HSOF-Ca2+ + 10% FBS and place in 'ESOF-Ca plate' in single 5 µL drops; incubate at 38.5 °C in 5% CO2 (atmospheric O2).
Equilibrate reconstructs by transferring to HSOF + 1 mg/ml BSA 5–30 minutes before activation.
Collect reconstructs and deposit into 5 µM ionomycin in HSOF + 1 mg/mL BSA for 4.5 minutes.
Wash through HSOF + 30 mg/ml BSA for at least 3 minutes.
Transfer reconstructs through three wash drops of 6-DMAP, then place into single 5 µL drops of 2 mM 6-DMAP.
Incubate for 3–4 hours at 38.5 °C in 5% CO2 (atmospheric O2).
Wash reconstructs thoroughly through two dishes of HSOF.

steps.title: Embryo Culture and Aggregation
steps.instruction: Culture zona-free embryos in modular incubation chambers (7% O2, 5% CO2 in N2).

substeps.instruction: Transfer embryos to 'ESOF plate', wash serially through two 40 µL drops, and place in manually prepared micro-wells (dimples made with 70% ethanol sterilized blunt needle) in groups of 10 in 20 µL.
On day two: refresh half of the medium (10 µL) with warm, gassed ESOF.
On day four: replace three quarters of the medium (15 µL) with warm, gassed LSOF.
On day five: remove embryos from micro-wells and place into single 5 µL drops of LSOF.
For aggregation: pair morulae of similar stage/grade. Incubate in disaggregation media for 2 minutes, wash in HSOF, and transfer to 5 µL LSOF drops with one micro-well.
Disaggregate embryos by blowing up and down with a 50-70 µm pipette until they break into 2-3 fragments.
Re-aggregate fragments with a pipette and place in a micro-well; incubate for 5–6 hours.
Remove aggregated embryos from micro-wells and place into single LSOF drops until day six or seven.

steps.title: Cryopreservation of Blastocysts
steps.instruction: Vitrify blastocysts using the CryoLogic method.

substeps.instruction: Wash blastocysts twice through base medium (Embryo-hold (no BSA) + 20% FBS).
Incubate in 7.5% (v/v) ethylene glycol and 7.5% (v/v) DMSO in base medium for 2 minutes.
Transfer to base medium with 0.1 mM Ficoll 70, 1 M sucrose, 15% (v/v) ethylene glycol, and 15% (v/v) DMSO for 30 seconds.
Collect embryos in 2.5 µl and deposit on the nylon hook of a CryoLogic fibreplug (1-4 embryos per hook).
Place the hook on a stainless-steel cooling block (equilibrated in liquid N2 for 15-20 s) and sheath in a cooled plastic cover; store in liquid N2.
Warming: submerge in 0.27 M sucrose in base medium for 2 minutes, then 0.16 M sucrose in base medium for 3 minutes, followed by two 2.5-minute incubations in base medium.
Recover in standard Embryo-hold medium (with BSA) and transfer within 2 hours.
